lore_anchors.definition: A single-use explosive artifact created by compressing a bolt of heavenly thunder into a portable orb; a classic high-stakes trump card that is consumed forever upon use.

A forbidden pill related to Core Formation, refined from the blood essence of five powerful elemental lifeforms; its creation typically requires ritual sacrifice of high-level cultivators or demon beasts.
A dark ritual where blood, life-force, or cultivation base is offered as fuel for power; in xianxia, it is a high-efficiency but karmically expensive shortcut to advancement.
The cultivation stage where a practitioner’s internal system becomes stable enough to support higher transformations; later stages demand increasingly brutal resource competition.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the blue-robed man willingly let the Yue Emperor drain him?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The text leaves it ambiguous—it could be a technique of absolute domination (a blood curse), a pre-arranged pact where his life is the price for a greater cause, or a deeper parasitic bond where the Yue Emperor controls his will entirely.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Heaven Thunder Seed?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a single-use artifact made from a compressed bolt of natural heavenly thunder—the same type of lightning a cultivator faces during tribulation—packed into a small bead that explodes with devastating force.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Han Li use the Heaven Thunder Seed earlier?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Heaven Thunder Seed is a one-shot trump card with no reload. Han Li waited for the most favorable moment—during the fusion ritual when the enemy was vulnerable—to maximize its effectiveness and catch the Yue Emperor off guard.
